name: evidence and oracle science
reason: This lens is covered better than most because a proving pack exists, which is unusual in this space. What it does not cover is measurement discipline: timing resolution, statistical power, multiple comparisons, oracle cost and the effect of defence noise on an oracle.

L14-001.note: Defining the observable per class before testing is the pack's stated procedure.

L14-002.note: Falsify first and run a control is the pack's core rule, and the critic exists to enforce it.

L14-003.note: Differential comparison is implied by the control rule rather than stated as its own step.

L14-004.note: Adversarial review is where a false positive rate would be argued.

L14-005.note: A second party reproducing from the package is the test.

L14-010.note: Both capture a full flow. Whether the capture is complete enough to replay is the open part.

L14-015.note: The smallest action recorded, with why a smaller one would not do, is side effect avoidance.

L14-017.note: Severity argued separately from the demonstrated fact is the separation.

L14-018.note: Every unverified premise listed as an assumption is the inventory.

L14-026.note: A defence altering the probe is the known failure mode this entry exploits.

L14-029.note: Two identities captured side by side is the procedure for showing cross principal impact, with the second principal's object as the oracle.

L14-041.note: A target with real tenancy makes the two tenant differential the designed test.

L14-042.note: Replaying as a lower privileged account is the role differential, stated with its confirmation.

L14-049.note: A stated disproof criterion is the falsify first rule in practice.

L14-006.note: Measured noise floor against the claimed effect is the resolution question.

L14-007.note: Sample count and test stated, which is the power question.

L14-045.note: Separation exceeding the floor is signal to noise.

L14-053.note: Cost per bit falls out of the same measurement.

L14-063.note: Validating the observer is what a critic would ask for, and it is not a procedure.

L14-013.note: Environment and versions inside the package is the factor.

L14-048.note: Independent replication is the whole point of the package.

L14-009.note: The success criterion written before the test is pre registration made visible.

L14-016.note: The same record answers the minimum proof principle.

L14-062.note: The stated cost of being wrong, and who accepted it, is the last part of that record.

L14-061.note: A confidence statement naming what could make it false is the confidence question.

L14-020.note: Stating what absence of a finding means is the false negative disclosure.

L14-057.note: An explicit out of scope list is the reported versus actual scope test.

L14-019.note: Demonstrated reach stated separately from the theoretical maximum.

L14-030.note: The field names disclosed, classified, rather than a general claim of exposure.

L14-032.note: The prerequisites listed, so a reader can tell rare from default.

L14-035.note: The redacted artefact still reproducing the observation is the whole test.

L14-050.note: The patch read against the mechanism, and the proof re-run against the fix.
